description: Catalog of fields a partner API key CAN be granted (the platform superset). The partner API (tatva_connect.api.partner) reads its catalog + routing FROM this table. Tick a subset per partner in CRM Lead API Mapping > Allowed Fields. Add a row here (+ the underlying doctype field) to expose a new partner field with no code change.

fields.label: Section
fields.description: The section this field belongs to — the ONE row that says which table holds it, whose columns it is, how a row is keyed and what the group is called. Required: every row in this table is a lead field. An activity's fields are not catalogued here at all — they live on the task type that declares them, and Smart Views asks it.

fields.label: Fieldname
fields.description: The fieldname on the target doctype.

fields.label: Filterable
fields.description: Smart Views: only filterable fields may reach a WHERE clause.

fields.label: Sortable
fields.description: Smart Views: only sortable fields may reach ORDER BY.

fields.label: Surface
fields.description: Smart Views display hint: worklist (column on the list) vs detail (drawer only).

fields.label: Automation Capabilities
fields.description: What the workflow/automation engine may do with this field. Folded here from the retired CRM Automation Field so there is one brain per resource.

fields.label: Automation: Readable
fields.description: A workflow criterion or Branch condition may test this field.

fields.label: Automation: Watchable
fields.description: A change to this field may fire a workflow (Updated trigger). Implies Readable.

fields.label: Automation: Settable
fields.description: A workflow action may write this field. Grain-scoped via the internal contract.

name: CRM Lead API Field
